occurrences.text: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
